title: I built DOMDIVE with Claude Code — a mobile-first procedural platformer
author: Silent-Assumption292
selftext:
​

I built DOMDIVE, a small browser game, using Claude Code directly in the project.

The game is a vertical platformer: your goal is to descend as far as possible while avoiding hazards and dealing with increasing difficulty. It runs in the browser, works on mobile, and lets you share a level so other people can play the same layout using its seed.

How I used Claude Code

I worked with Claude Code directly in the project's codebase, using it to help implement and develop the gameplay. Rather than generating a standalone demo in one shot, I built the game as a project and iterated on its implementation with Claude Code.

The goal was to get the actual game playable and enjoyable, especially the movement and moment-to-moment gameplay.

DOMDIVE is a static website, free to play, with no account required.

Play it here: https://domdive.net

I'd appreciate honest feedback, especially on how the gameplay feels, the difficulty curve, and whether the game makes you want to retry after a failed run.
